When a second session boundary occurs on the same day, the Stop checklist still directs the orchestrator to create and auto-merge another boundary PR, and the SKILL explicitly permits `boundary-<date>-2`; meanwhile `scripts/check-regime-boundary.sh` contains no date or boundary-merge-history check. Thus `make check-regime-boundary` can pass while the new once-a-day invariant is violated. Either implement the promised check and reconcile the multi-boundary procedure, or stop claiming that this command enforces the limit. The task's residual control for this trust-boundary rule therefore does not mitigate the behavioral mismatch.
